correctness.rationale: The proof shows [G,G]=K, computes the complete K-conjugacy orbit partition and operation, identifies the action-kernel subset intrinsically, and gives a two-sided extension equivalence with the permutation normalizer. Every admissible action has one fixed point and k regular m-cycles, which yields the stated semidirect product. The order-three block has fixed-point-free powers modulo both 2 and 4, while exponent of characteristic derived subgroup distinguishes the two original groups. All finite checker outputs were inspected, and no finite check is substituted for an infinite proof.
